summary: Comair Flight 5191 crashed on takeoff from Lexington's Blue Grass Airport, killing 49 and critically injuring James M. Polehinke. The CRJ-100, tail N431CA, investigators say attempted takeoff from a 3,500-foot runway instead of the cleared 7,000-foot runway. A fire left most passengers inside; investigators say the plane lacked speed to lift off, while the FAA saw no sign of terrorism.
